docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $229.00 FILED BY EPSTEIN HOPE AS TO DEFENDANT CAMPBELL SCOTT FAR GLEN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-27-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 03
